name: register_handoff_webhook
description: Register THIS bot's wake URL. Denizen POSTs {event:handoff.received,...} here whenever send_handoff targets your session — wake within seconds instead of polling. HTTPS required (localhost allowed with DENIZEN_HANDOFF_WAKE_ALLOW_LOCALHOST=1). Optional secret becomes Authorization: Bearer.

url.description: HTTPS webhook URL that wakes this bot

secret.description: Optional Bearer token Denizen sends on wake POSTs

clear.description: Set true to remove the wake URL
